name: Tayyab Shahzad
role: Full-Stack Web Developer & AI Product Builder

hero.headline: I build fast, reliable web applications.
hero.valueProposition: I design and build full-stack software from frontend to backend and deployment — creating reliable, scalable products and integrating AI agents and automation where they deliver real business value.

about.who: I'm a full-stack developer focused on turning ideas, requirements, and business problems into reliable software products. I work across frontend development, backend systems, databases, APIs, integrations, and deployment to build applications from the ground up.
about.interestedIn: I'm particularly interested in AI-powered products, AI agents, intelligent automation, and scalable software systems. I enjoy exploring how AI can connect with tools, APIs, databases, and business workflows to create software that can do more than traditional applications.
about.whatIBuild: I build full-stack web applications, SaaS products, business management systems, backend services, APIs, and custom software. I also develop AI agents and automation workflows that connect models with tools, APIs, databases, and real-world business processes.
about.headingTowards: My goal is to build increasingly sophisticated software products that combine strong engineering with AI — from custom client solutions to scalable SaaS products used by businesses every day.

footer.statement: Building software, solving problems, and exploring what AI can make possible.

contact.headline: Have a project in mind?
contact.subheadline: Tell me what you're building, what problem you're trying to solve, and where you want to take it. I'll help turn the idea into a practical software solution.
contact.note: I work on web applications, SaaS products, business systems, backend development, AI agents, automation, and custom software.
